description: In every PA model, for a fixed Boolean program \(q(\vec x,i)\), its specified accumulation loop has a Boolean value at every internal length \(j\), and that value is one exactly when \(q(\vec x,i)=1\) for every \(i<j\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop_spec.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  {r : ℕ} (q : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.Program (r + 1)) (x : Fin r → M)
  (hq :
    ∀ (i : M),
      Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BooleanValue (q.value (Fin.snoc x i)))
  (k : M) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BooleanValue
      ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop q).value
        (Fin.snoc x k)) ∧
    ((Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.CheckerPrograms.BoundedTruthPrograms.allLoop q).value
          (Fin.snoc x k) =
        Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1 ↔
      ∀ (i : M),
        Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
            (Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M i) k →
          q.value (Fin.snoc x i) = Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.ArithmeticTheories.numeralValue M 1)
